message: 事故ですかそうですか違いますか
Ugh... This is awkward.
Nanaka said to forget about it, but whenever I look at her face, I can't help remembering.
My eyes keep drifting to those soft, small lips...

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Nanaka... it really... is bothering you, isn't it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I told you we're not talking about that anymore! I'm fine, it doesn't bother me at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「I... I see. Well, if you say so, then good.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aren't you the one making too big a deal out of it...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course I am...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Really...?」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, I stole your first kiss, Nanaka...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaa--?! D-Don't say something so embarrassing!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What about... you, huh?! It was probably your first time too anyway!\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「You hit the nail on the head.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then we're even!! Therefore, if we just forget about it, there's no problem」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah... I'll try my best not to let it bother me.」
I guess Nanaka really does want to forget what happened.
Can we really go back to the way things were just by forgetting...?

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's that for?! Was doing that with me so awful that you have to sigh over it?!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not it! It's nothing like that--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That was an accident! So it couldn't be helped! So don't go sighing about it either! Forbidden!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Master Synn. You've been staring at the ceiling like that for a while now. Don't you gotta study for tomorrow?」

name: Synn
message: 「No... I will... of course」

name: Paqy
message: 「No use worrying about it」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The kiss, obviously」

name: Synn
message: 「How do you know about that!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Listen up. Yours truly is basically with Master Synn all the time. Though I did miss the decisive moment」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean, 'decisive moment'!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, she's telling you to forget it, and it's not like you can't just chalk it up as an accident」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe... that's true, but...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well. How Master Synn feels about it is a whole different story, though」
My feelings.
These feelings welling up inside me, triggered by that kiss...
Yet Nanaka is stubbornly trying to reject them.
If I were to kiss her intentionally, rather than by accident...
What would become of our relationship...
